purpose: Record the scope of the completed available-history exposure review; interpretation and release decisions belong to docs/PUBLIC_RELEASE.md.
status: No blocking disclosure identified in reviewed available material; repository private and PRs unmerged at inspection.

git.npz_method: Read existing local ZIP headers and DEFLATE streams, check completion and CRC, and inspect numeric NPY payloads. All present bytes accounted for; central directories remain missing. No file repaired or historical scientific output recovered.
git.text_method: Pattern-screen every distinct blob and expanded payload; read every commit message and identity entry; inspect flagged text and historical presentation/provenance changes in context. Safe numeric headers only; no pickle loading or archive program execution.

actions.logs_method: Pattern screen of all retrieved log text with contextual inspection of credential, contact, URL and workflow/import candidates. Masked values were neither recovered nor tested.
actions.artifact_method: Read every artifact ZIP; recursive ZIP/TAR/gzip inflation, safe NPY headers and raw bytes; UTF-8/raw pattern checks; PDF text/metadata/fonts; PNG metadata; data-URI base64 inflation. No pickle execution, archive code execution, image OCR, general credential scanner, or scientific rerun.

artifact_dispositions.credential_and_private_link_patterns: Zero matches for private keys, common GitHub/service tokens, credential-bearing URLs, quoted secret assignments, private conversation/share URLs and signed-URL parameters. Pattern coverage is bounded; absence of matches is not certification.
artifact_dispositions.emails: Two distinct historical CITATION.cff payloads retain the known author Gmail. Remaining text matches are Python matrix multiplication expressions; raw TAR matches duplicate their contained members. No new contact identity found.
artifact_dispositions.workspace_paths: Seven distinct leaf provenance/design-manifest payloads contain historical /mnt/data paths. Two raw TAR hits duplicate their contained members. These are provenance paths, not credential or private download links.
artifact_dispositions.other_project: Manual context review found My-tone version/source references, an explicit channel-capacity exclusion in the source-bundle manifest, and false positives where the case-insensitive LoRA pattern matches exploratory. No My-tone corpus or separate-project payload was identified.
artifact_dispositions.historical_web_previews: Five website-preview artifacts contain identical three screenshots, superseded website/palette pages and original-study downloads. Another verified-repository-preview artifact also stores the built site and its source TAR. These remain historical presentation material, not the accepted current GitHub reading route.
artifact_dispositions.unparsed_content: No artifact or nested-container parse errors. All 309 distinct NPY payloads have numeric, bool or complex dtypes; no object arrays were unpickled. The separate Git-file coverage is recorded above.
artifact_dispositions.visual_limit: Only the three unique historical website screenshots were visually inspected. Numerical PNGs and PDFs received raw/text/metadata checks as applicable, not a new visual scientific audit.

historical_screenshots.finding: Historical scientific landing page or palette guide; no visible credentials, private conversation, unrelated personal material or contact detail.

inventory_digests.serialization: For each inventory, UTF-8 encode lexicographically sorted records joined by LF, with one final LF; report SHA-256. Separator within multi-field records is one ASCII space.

known_retained_exposure: Existing author email in historical CFF files, Git author/committer and Actions run metadata, and historical source copies in artifacts; the address is not repeated in this record.
Historical workspace paths, migration and repair attempts, superseded labels, and website/palette previews remain historical records.
My-tone references are versioned presentation attribution; no private corpus identified. No separate-project payload identified.
limits: Available refs and retained GitHub records at the pinned snapshot; deleted/unreachable objects, deleted or earlier edited discussion text, and deleted/expired artifacts are outside coverage.
Credential formats, private keys, credential-bearing URLs, secret assignments, contacts, local paths and private-link patterns were checked. This is bounded inspection, not a security certification.
Account security settings and secret values were not queried.
Only three distinct historical screenshots were visually inspected. No new GitHub rendering, mobile, accessibility, OCR or visual scientific validation is claimed.
External editable composite sources and external Overleaf material were not recovered or inspected.
No science, historical record, asset, workflow or data was changed by the exposure review. No history deletion, merge, visibility change or publication occurred.
